messages:
Maya Chen: Headsup — GenovaHealth sent back a vendor questionnaire. They want: confirmation SOC2 covers hosted inference, embeddings retention policy, and the exact prompt set we use for evaluation. Asking for a copy of sample prompts to validate outputs.
Arjun Patel: For SOC2 we can confirm our hosted API is in-scope (control mapping + certs). Keep wording high level, link to /security/soc2-summary. :lock:
Lara Gomez: Do NOT send raw prompt sets. Legal won't approve sharing production prompt collections — they can include customer data. We can provide redacted templates and a short description of our eval process.
Samir K: For embeddings retention: default retention for hosted is 90 days for raw inputs + embeddings metadata, unless customer requests immediate purge. Dedicated/Private customers can control retention via config. I can paste the retention blurb we use.
Maya Chen: OK — I'll assemble a response. Suggested pieces: 1) SOC2 statement link 2) retention paragraph 3) redacted prompt templates + guidance on redaction 4) optional step: offer a gated review call.
Lara Gomez: That sounds fine. For the redacted templates, provide examples where PII is replaced with <REDACTED>. Also add a short checklist: "do not include any customer-owned PII or proprietary prompts".
Arjun Patel: Also include a note about embeddings encryption at rest and BYOK for Private customers. Keep it one paragraph.
onboard-bot: Ticket GEN-45321 created for GenovaHealth questionnaire. Owner: Maya Chen. Due: 2025-04-09.
Maya Chen: Draft reply (will send after approvals):
```
Hi GenovaHealth — thanks for the questionnaire. Quick answers:
1) SOC2: Our hosted inference platform is covered by Redwood Inference's SOC2 Type II; summary and controls map: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2-summary
2) Embeddings retention: By default we retain raw inputs and generated embeddings for 90 days in hosted mode; Dedicated/Private customers may configure retention and BYOK options. We can schedule a data-purge on request.
3) Prompt examples: we cannot share production prompt collections. Attached are redacted prompt templates and the eval guidelines used to generate them (examples have PII replaced with <REDACTED>).
If you'd like, we can do a short call to walk the team through the materials.
```
Arjun Patel: Looks good. Add a line about encryption and audit logs.
Maya Chen: Added. Sending draft to legal for a quick sign-off @Lara Gomez.
Lara Gomez: Reviewing now, will ping with edits in 30m. :eyes:
Samir K: FYI — if they ask for proof of purge, we should share the purge runbook steps and retention logs (redacted). I can prepare the runbook snippet.
Maya Chen: Cool. I'll wait for Lara then send. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Lara Gomez: Approved with one tiny wording tweak. Send when ready.
Maya Chen: Sent to the customer — they acknowledged receipt and asked for the redacted templates attached. Closing ticket after follow-up.
